_doc: Gus's first-day walkthrough (TutorialGuide). On the owner's first morning Gus is still in town: it's his handoff before the flight to Florida. He waits inside the front doors with a coffee and asks if you want his help (his dialogue tree, node tutorial_ask). Yes: he walks you through `steps` in order, going ahead to each waypoint. No: the tutorial is off, saved, and he leaves for the airport. Each step: id, say (Gus, when the step starts), hint (the HUD line), waypoint (a PlaceMap place or [x, y, z] in venue space), label (the floating marker), done (conditions, any one finishes it), done_say (Gus, when it's done). Condition types: job (a RinkSim job id finished through RinkLife), flag (a WalkStory flag), room (the owner is standing in that room), screen (a walk screen opened), session (a session of that event kind is on), flood (any good flood today), quest [id, status], talk (person id), signal (anything another system passes to TutorialGuide.notify). Steps can be added by other systems: TutorialGuide.add_step(step, after_id).
leave_line: Flight's at four. Don't touch breaker 14. G.

steps.label: PLANT ROOM
steps.say: Plant room first. Every morning. Oil first, number 1 drinks. Read the gauges into the log book, pencil's on a string.
steps.hint: Do the plant round: read the gauges into the log book in the plant room.
steps.done_say: Good. Write it down even when it's boring. Especially when it's boring.

steps.label: ICE CHECK
steps.say: Now the ice. Screwdriver's on the bench. Push it in at the blue line. Goes in easy, she's soft. Bounces, we have problems.
steps.hint: Check the ice: use the screwdriver at the players' bench.
steps.done_say: That's the whole science. Earl will tell you it's an art. Earl is wrong.

steps.label: OFFICE
steps.say: Office. The phone rings, the bills sit on the desk, the corkboard tells you what this week wants. Don't let the corkboard bully you.
steps.done_say: That chair has a lean. You'll get used to it. I never did.

steps.label: DORIS
steps.say: Meet Doris. 1974 Zambelli. If she won't start it's the plugs. It's always the plugs. Unless it's the choke.
steps.hint: Get Doris running: new spark plugs, in the Zamboni bay.
steps.done_say: Hear that? That's the best sound in the building. Don't tell the Lumber Kings.

steps.label: FIRST FLOOD
steps.say: Now flood. Slow and straight, overlap your passes, dump the snow before the pit fills. Ice is only as good as the last flood.
steps.hint: Do the first flood with Doris (or let the morning flood run).
steps.done_say: Look at that sheet. You did that. Well, Doris did that. You helped.

steps.label: ICE GRID
steps.say: Last thing. Friday and Saturday afternoons, public skate. That's the money and the town's good mood. Look at the ice grid, see what's booked and what isn't.
steps.hint: Open the ice grid in the office and find the public skates.
steps.done_say: Fill the empty hours and the place pays for itself. Mostly. Sometimes. Once, in 1988.
